anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheets the two isolated CAN buses are broken out on the M12 connectors J16 (CAN Interface A) and J9 (CAN Interface B). The differential pairs run from the isolated transceivers U16/U11 (CANH/CANL pins) through the isolation optocouplers D36/D46 and the 120R termination resistors (R40/R54) straight to the connector pins. No CDSOT23-SM712 (or any other) TVS diode array is drawn on the CAN0_P/N or CAN1_P/N lines; the only TVS parts on the board are the TPD4E1U06DCKR arrays U45/U8 on the Ethernet pairs and the USBLC6-2P6 arrays U17/U37 on the USB lines.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table lists D9/D10 — CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N and CAN1_P/N as the documented CAN transient/ESD protection ('the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice'). The intended design therefore places a CAN-rated TVS array on each external CAN differential pair.

evidence.quote: D9, D10 — CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N — CAN bus transient/ESD protection ... the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice.
CAN BUS sheet: J16 'CAN Interface A' / J9 'CAN Interface B' with R40 120R, R54 120R and optocouplers D36/D46 on the CANH/CANL lines, and no SM712/TVS part present on those nets.

anomalies.impact: The external CAN buses (which connect to the Odrive motor controllers over long cabling on a field rover) lose their specified transient/ESD protection. ESD or burst events on the M12 CAN connectors can reach and damage the isolated transceivers and CAN controllers, a reliability deviation from the documented design. This is not one of the spec's listed known issues.

parsed.summary: The build implements the documented architecture (CM4 carrier, two MCP2515 CAN controllers with 16 MHz crystals, isolated transceivers, LTC4412 USB ideal-diode, ISL54222 routing, WS2812B chain, e-stop sinks), and the apparent oddities (USB diode, GLOBAL_EN buffer, CAN LED/e-stop polarity, POE inversion, HDMI fuse) are explicitly documented known issues and are not reported. The one deviation I can support from the drawing is the absence of the CDSOT23-SM712 TVS arrays that the spec states belong on the CAN0/CAN1 differential pairs, leaving the external CAN connectors without their intended ESD/transient protection.
